_comment: EXPANDED PLACEHOLDER labels for the Rupandehi District (Terai) pilot, Lumbini Province, Nepal. 64 polygons (8 per crop class), programmatically scattered across farmland near Siddharthanagar/Bhairahawa with randomized jitter. This is STILL SYNTHETIC data, not field-verified ground truth -- there is no way to know what is actually growing at these exact coordinates without a real survey or a real dataset. The improvement over the earlier 8-polygon set is purely about having enough points per class (8 instead of 1) for the held-out accuracy evaluation to produce non-degenerate numbers (app/gee/features.py:evaluate_classifier) -- it does NOT make the classification itself trustworthy. Replace with real labels before drawing any real conclusions; see project_plan.md section 3 for concrete leads (ICIMOD/SERVIR-HKH, RicePAL). crop_class ids match app.config.Settings.crop_classes: 0=non_crop 1=rice 2=wheat 3=maize 4=sugarcane 5=lentil 6=mustard 7=vegetables.
